_comment: Per-MODULE champion registry for the Ladrillo benchmark. Promotion is manual and
'tag' must have a frozen snapshot under benchmark/reference/<tag>/.
Champions are per module because a change that improves one module and leaves the
others untouched should not silently take credit for them.

ais.why: Marcus 2026-09-20: priors that are priors (DAISfastdyn marginals; L24's were BRICK 2.0's posterior +-2 sd), the published glacier target scored (no delta ramp; u_unch 33-37 mm carries the early century), bands as a correlated error L=100 (the Antarctic runoff onset becomes +2.2 K [1.4,3.2] instead of 1998 +-0.1 K), T_off bound -4, kappa-P0 reparam; 55 params. Glaciers/total hindcast 2x closer, AIS/GIS give back exact tracking (still 0.06x/0.28x BRICK); AIC/BIC verdict unchanged with dk 20. Not a one-axis comparison; notes/note_2026-09-20_ais_reduction_and_L26_vs_L24.md.
